short_description:
Years between each new main GTA game, from the US release dates: GTA III (Oct 2001) to Vice City (Oct 2002) 1 year; Vice City to San Andreas (Oct 2004) 2; San Andreas to GTA IV (Apr 2008) 3.5; GTA IV to GTA V (Sept 17, 2013) 5.4; GTA V to GTA 6 (Nov 19, 2026) 13.2. How old were you when GTA 5 came out?

Sources: GamesRadar GTA timeline, Dot Esports release order, Sportskeeda release dates, Rockstar Intel timeline.
